resourceProfile.assessment: Canonical English, complete effective Bengali runtime content, repository checks, and targeted Bengali technical terminology searches were available.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review generation and TypeScript checking passed after every correction batch.

linguisticCritique.summary: Three complete-scope passes resolved 73 catalog, shared-interface, comparison, coil, TCR, and Wire Wizard findings.

competentHumanReview.summary: The Bengali corrections were machine-reviewed and still require competent human review.

publicationAuthorization.summary: This cycle authorizes a locale-specific commit only, not publication or deployment.

findings.summary: Twenty-five SI-symbol, circuit, catalog-note, shared-label, and mod-comparison defects remained in effective Bengali content.
evidence: One SI explanation still displayed literal Unicode escape sequences.
Several battery and mod notes were ambiguous or grammatically malformed.
Atomizer resistance and mod comparison labels used inconsistent technical terms.
findings.resolution: Restored visible symbols and precise circuit prose, rewrote battery and mod notes, and standardized shared and comparison terminology.

findings.summary: Twenty-five coil, TCR, and Wire Wizard labels used literal wrapping, base, loop, and resistance-factor calques.
evidence: Wrap spacing described package wrapping rather than spacing between coil turns.
Loop labels used a software-loop term rather than coil geometry.
TCR labels mixed resistance terminology and unclear base-value wording.
findings.resolution: Applied natural Bengali terms for coil turns, reference resistance, geometry, resistance curves, and wire construction.

findings.summary: Twenty-three remaining result labels inconsistently expressed electrical power, resistance, thermal properties, and per-unit measurements.
evidence: Power labels mixed transliteration with the established Bengali engineering term.
Wire Wizard result headings were bare adjectives rather than property groups.
Several resistance labels retained machine-literal phrasing.
findings.resolution: Standardized electrical power, resistance, heat-flux, thermal-property, and Wire Wizard result terminology across the effective locale.
